Episode 188. Reunion with Let
[Let!]
[Is it really Let? We’ve been forgetting about you even though you existed like this……!]
Tears welled up in the large eyes of the Muein tribe.

-[Tell our friend inside. Neru, representing the Muein tribe, thanks him for his thousand years of lonely effort, and that we had a hard time. Even if I try to remember, I can't remember who he was now…….]
These were the words Neru said when Jin first found the third tomb.
The Muein tribe were overwhelmed by the fact that they had finally met their old friend, whom they only recently remembered.
Could this be the end of a thousand years of solitude?
Let was motionless for a while, watching Jin and his group appear in front of him.
He had been communicating with Valeria all along, but it didn’t feel real to see the door actually open.
"Yes. We've come to keep our promise, housemaster."
Jin extended his hand into the room and said.
Let stared at his hand for a moment, then looked around and behind him.
The landscape that was a recreation of the storm from a thousand years ago.
It was a place where he once always spent time with his loved ones and colleagues, but after they all fell, it was full of nothing but deep sorrow and loneliness.
That landscape was shaking and losing its form.
It was a phenomenon caused by forcibly opening the empty space.
Now was the time to leave this place and head towards the light, where their past selves had left behind.
Let slowly moved his steps and held Jin's hand.
Feeling the warmth of another person for the first time in a long time, his eyes welled up with tears.
[Oh, showing a vulnerable side right after we meet again.]
"Don't worry about it, you don't feel that way at all."
[Let! It's me, me, Neru! Do you recognize us?]
[It was lonely inside, wasn't it?]
[Neru, Lulu, Miru…… I see that you are all safe.]
[Housemaster, aren't you going to be glad to see me too?]
Let looked back at Veil, and his brows furrowed.
Veil seemed to cough awkwardly at that rather unwelcoming gaze.

[……Veil. Although you were disappointing a thousand years ago, it seems you have now found your duty as one of the ten knights again, following Jin. I guess it was Jin who released you from the seal.]
The ones who sealed Veil were the ten knights of that time.
Let remembered the times when Veil went berserk and destroyed the world every day after Sara's death.
["Ah, umm... I guess so, isn't it?"]
["I'm not saying I don't understand your sorrow. But have you ever thought about how we felt, having to seal away a comrade who went berserk?"]
Even when Veil first woke up from the seal in the Sea of Swords, he seemed to be in a very comfortable relationship with Lehet, but in reality, that was not the case.
His spirit instantly fell at Lehet's voice, and he mumbled.
["Uh, sorry..."]

["Remember this, such a thing should never happen again. Jin just called me a housekeeper, and that's probably because I still have to perform that role as I did back then. So, I'm going to watch over you as the housekeeper of the clan. Do you understand?"]
Veil might have been expected to object immediately and complain, but he glanced around nervously and nodded heavily.
In the past, Lehet had also disciplined the Ten Knights, including Veil.
Seeing Veil getting instantly gloomy and bowing his head, Lehet smiled and patted his shoulder.
["Of course, I'm not saying I'm not happy to see you. I'm grateful that you came back now."]
["Yeah! Hehe, I've got my senses back, really."]
With a cunning teacher and a soft-hearted troublemaker, Jin thought to himself and chuckled.
Lehet's gaze fell on Valeria.
Ever since Lehet came out, Valeria had been unknowingly gripping her yew wand tightly.
["Valeria Hister. You are the Record Mage Jin spoke about. Using a power similar to our fairies..."]
Lehet and Valeria had just had a resonant conversation, but that was mostly about how to open the void.
Lehet still didn't know that the name Hister was spoken by the will of the fairies.
Yet, the moment Lehet saw Valeria in person, he felt an indescribable sense of familiarity.
No, it had been that way since their resonance.
There was no need for the party to explain that situation.
As Lehet gently waved his hand in the air, a bright blue record window rose up, and a video was played inside.
The video depicted a woman who resembled Lehet and Valeria, and Shila.
"All the fairies who fought against Zip until the end have been forgotten."
"Human, what on earth are you talking about all of a sudden?"

"But their souls, their final records, turned into seeds and permeated the nature of this world. The seed flowed painfully around the world for four hundred years and finally sprouted to birth a human... that is me, Minka Hister. You need to know this, cursed fairy descendant king."
It was the very day that Minka Hister, the founder of the Hister family, went to see Shila.
Lehet and Valeria couldn't take their eyes off Minka in the video for a while.
For Lehet, it was the moment when he confirmed the existence of a descendant he didn't know about, and for Valeria, it was the moment when she saw the founder of her family.
["Just as Runcandel left a spark named Jin, our kind left a light named Valeria. Now I understand what Jin said to me back then. Our kind, they were your roots..."]
Luret gently hugged Valeria.
[I've heard you are the last survivor of the Histers. I suspect your life has been filled with trials and sorrows. I hope my return can bring you some comfort, even if just a little.]
Valeria held back her tears, fighting the urge to let them flow.
She didn't want to show Luret any signs of weakness.
Instead of comforting Valeria who was suppressing her feelings, Luret nodded his head, as if acknowledging her strength.
'I didn't feel this during our last encounter, but you do have a leader-like vibe. Well, given that Veil doesn't even dare to make a sound, it seems you were quite a strict steward.'
Jin felt reassured by Luret's presence.

[That's a good stance, Miss Valeria. It's best to endure when you can. Of course, comfort is important, but now is a time when determination and a sense of mission are more important. We are not yet complete. I don't fully remember the past thousand years, and my powers have significantly weakened. Your magic is probably not complete either.]
"Yes, Lord Luret."
[From now on, let's work together to reclaim what we've lost. From now on, I would like to use the name Luret Hister, not Luret Damirool. It's the name left by my kin. Would you allow me to do so?]
Valeria continuously nodded her head.
Seeing her resemble a girl facing a respectable elder, Jin smiled.
It was a sight he had never seen in his past life.
[Jin.]
"Yes."
[What is your current position within the family?]
"I'm the 12th generation and a junior house head."
[And the current head?]
"He is absent. I will explain more later."
[So, before the head returns, can I work under the assumption that there is no one above me other than you?]
"There will be a lot of work for you to do."
[Understood. I will formally greet you again, junior house head. As your steward, I will carry out my duties and solve the affairs of the Runecandel. I am Luret Hister.]
As Luret knelt down and offered his respect, Jin could only be taken aback.
This was how their ancestors always reacted, even those from a distant past.
But soon, Luret chastised him in a calm and quiet voice.
[Whether it's me or Temar kneeling, even if a god kneels, you, as a junior house head, should not be taken aback but remain dignified.]
As Jin pondered on how to respond, he nodded his head with a stern expression.
"I understand. Stand up now, and I will introduce you to the members of the family and the allies of the Barmel Alliance."
[Yes, junior house head. I look forward to it.]
Before taking Luret to Runecandel and Tikan, they needed to stop by the Wontaramo Forest first.
The Beastkin, who had already developed a significant fondness for Sheila, felt uneasy at the sight of Leat's strong and firm character, which they had forgotten.
Perhaps to Leat, Sheila could simply be a foolish betrayer.
When they arrived back in the Wantaromo Forest through the Beastkin's dimension gate, Sheila greeted the party by folding her wings.
"[...Sister.]"
Sheila looked up at Leat with uneasy eyes, and Leat looked down at her with an unreadable gaze.
She had wanted so much to see her sister, but now that she was face-to-face, it was difficult to figure out how to start the conversation.
"[Sheil Damiro.]"
Leat called Sheila by her old name.
Seeing Sheila's attitude, the other fairy descendants also lowered their bodies in fear of Leat. The fairy descendants who had regained their memories of Leat felt ashamed.
"[Sister, I am......]"
"[After meeting for the first time in a thousand years, you're not going to make excuses, are you?]"
Sheila bit her lower lip and bowed her head.
"[No, I just want to apologize. To you, to our forgotten and vanished kin. Even if it's a meaningless apology.]"

"[Yes, you know well. Late regrets and apologies have no value. A thousand years ago, you were disappointed that I was endangering our kin, but look at the result. Those who fought to the end, including me, left descendants called Hister, and you who shirked your duty were cursed by the witch.]"
Sheila couldn't respond and bowed her head.
"[However, I believe you have paid enough.]"
"[...Sister?]"
"[So now, don't make the same mistake... When it's time to fight, when those trying to save the world need your power, risk your life and step forward.]"
Sheila's eyes widened.
"[If I do as you say, will you forgive me?]"
"[What you need is not my forgiveness but your own. So, you don't need to ask me for forgiveness. I never hated you.]"
At those words, Sheila burst into tears, her head on the ground. Leat helped her up and said,
"[Yul, from now on, I'll give you a name that only the Fairy King can have. Watch and see what role you all play in the decisive moment. If you shun it again, I will take that name away.]"
"[That will never, never happen!]"

"[Is that so? Then you are now a member of the Bamel Alliance. If there's anything you need, contact either your clan or the Bamel Alliance. Let's go now. Don't forget that heart and take good care of yourself, my sister.]"
With those words, Leat immediately walked towards the edge of the forest.
Sheila, no, Sheil Damiro Yul, couldn't take her eyes off her departing sister's back until she disappeared.
